headers.subject: Offer for Platform Engineer at Bramble Studio

snippet: Hi Mateo, everyone on the team enjoyed meeting you. We would like to offer you the Platform Engineer position at Bramble Studio. Details attached below.
bodyText:
Hi Mateo,

Everyone on the team enjoyed meeting you. We would like to offer you the Platform Engineer position at Bramble Studio. The offer details are at https://people.bramble-studio.example/offers/pe-0412 and I am happy to walk through them on a call.

Best regards,
Ines Duarte
Head of people, Bramble Studio

extraction.summary: Bramble Studio offered you the Platform Engineer position.
